title: ABG: acid–base reading

findings.title: The comparison references a hidden pH line
findings.problem: The caption and narration ask students to notice that the acid end is opposite the pH line, but this step renders only the PaCO₂ gauge. The comparison being explained is not visible.
findings.fix: Include both "ph" and "co2" in this step's focus so students can compare the two lines directly.

assessment: No verified clinical blocker found. One minor visual mismatch needs correction.
